proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13952 haḍḍa lists Oriya hāṛa, Hindi haḍḍī, Gujarati hāḍ and Marathi hāḍ bone; the addendum explicitly includes hāṛkɔ and hāḍkī. These bone forms fit that family, including k-extended forms. The remote connection to asthi is explicitly very doubtful. Exact survey form haddī is retained; possible cross-Indo-Aryan transmission does not exclude this lexical-family link.

These survey responses match that family; the ultimate non-Aryan source remains unsettled. Exact survey form cāūr is retained; possible cross-Indo-Aryan transmission does not exclude this lexical-family link.
